"""Tests for handling wide characters (e.g. Japanese, emoji, CJK) in terminal tables."""

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestBasicJapaneseAlignment:
    """Test that columns line up correctly with Japanese text."""

    def test_simple_japanese_names(self):
        """Columns should align when cells contain Japanese characters."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024.pdf", 12], ["notes.txt", 3], ["議事録.docx", 48]],
            ["name", "KB"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Header line
        assert lines[0].startswith("name")
        # Separator should have proper alignment
        assert "-+-" in lines[1]
        # All data rows should have properly aligned columns
        # The | should be in the same column for all rows
        separator_positions = [line.find(" | ") for line in lines[2:]]
        assert len(set(separator_positions)) == 1, "Columns should line up"

    def test_mixed_ascii_and_japanese(self):
        """Columns should align with mixed ASCII and Japanese content."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["file1.txt", 10],
                ["ファイル.pdf", 20],
                ["doc.xlsx", 15],
            ],
            ["name", "size"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify the separator column is at the same position for all rows
        separator_positions = [line.find(" | ") for line in lines[2:]]
        assert len(set(separator_positions)) == 1, "Columns should line up"

    def test_japanese_in_multiple_columns(self):
        """Columns should align when Japanese text is in multiple columns."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["データ", "情報"],
                ["test", "data"],
                ["ファイル", "ドキュメント"],
            ],
            ["Col1", "Col2"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        separator_positions = [line.find(" | ") for line in lines[2:]]
        assert len(set(separator_positions)) == 1, "Columns should line up"


class TestJapaneseTruncation:
    """Test that truncation with max_width handles wide characters correctly."""

    def test_truncate_japanese_text(self):
        """Truncation should respect display width of Japanese characters."""
        # Japanese text should be truncated based on visual width, not character count
        # "レポート" is 4 Japanese chars (8 visual columns) + "_2024.pdf" is 9 chars
        # With max_width=10, we should truncate the Japanese part appropriately
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024.pdf", "data"]],
            max_width=10,
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # First data row should have truncated first column
        first_row = lines[0]
        # The first column should end with ellipsis
        assert "…" in first_row
        # It shouldn't exceed max_width visual columns
        # (allowing for potential off-by-one due to ellipsis width)
        first_cell = first_row.split(" | ")[0].strip()
        assert len(first_cell) <= 11  # At most max_width + ellipsis

    def test_truncate_mixed_content(self):
        """Truncation should work correctly with mixed ASCII and Japanese."""
        result = render(
            [["hello世界everyone", "x"]],
            max_width=8,
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        first_cell = lines[0].split(" | ")[0].strip()
        # Should have truncation marker
        assert "…" in first_cell

    def test_truncate_pure_japanese(self):
        """Pure Japanese text should truncate at appropriate visual width."""
        result = render(
            [["日本語テキスト", "data"]],
            max_width=5,
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        first_cell = lines[0].split(" | ")[0].strip()
        assert "…" in first_cell


class TestJapaneseWrapping:
    """Test that wrapping with max_width handles wide characters correctly."""

    def test_wrap_japanese_text(self):
        """Wrapping should respect display width of Japanese characters."""
        result = render(
            [["日本語テキスト説明", "x"]],
            max_width=5,
            wrap=True,
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should have multiple lines due to wrapping
        assert len(lines) > 1

    def test_wrap_mixed_ascii_japanese(self):
        """Wrapping should handle mixed ASCII and Japanese correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["hello 世界 test", "x"]],
            max_width=7,
            wrap=True,
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify that columns are still aligned after wrapping
        separator_positions = []
        for line in lines:
            if " | " in line:
                separator_positions.append(line.find(" | "))
        # At least some lines should have the separator
        assert len(separator_positions) > 0
        # All separator positions should be the same
        if len(separator_positions) > 1:
            assert len(set(separator_positions)) == 1


class TestWideCharacterWidth:
    """Test proper calculation of display width for various character types."""

    def test_column_width_calculation_japanese(self):
        """Column width should be calculated based on visual width."""
        # Japanese "レポート" (4 chars) should be treated as width 8 visually
        result = render(
            [["レポート", "x"]],
            ["name", "y"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Header should have same column position as data
        header_sep = lines[0].find(" | ")
        data_sep = lines[2].find(" | ")
        assert header_sep == data_sep, "Column separator should be at same position"

    def test_column_width_ascii_vs_japanese(self):
        """Column width should correctly balance ASCII and Japanese widths."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["データ", "100"],  # Japanese is wider
                ["file", "200"],    # ASCII is narrower
            ],
            ["name", "value"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        separator_positions = [line.find(" | ") for line in lines[2:]]
        assert len(set(separator_positions)) == 1

class TestReportedIssue:
    """Test the exact scenario reported by the user."""

    def test_file_listing_with_japanese_names(self):
        """
        Reproduce the exact issue: file listing with Japanese names and sizes.

        The user reported:
        name          | KB | modified
        レポート_2024.pdf | 12 | 2024-11-02
        notes.txt     |  3 | 2024-11-20
        議事録.docx      | 48 | 2024-10-15

        The columns should line up correctly.
        """
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート_2024.pdf", 12, "2024-11-02"],
                ["notes.txt", 3, "2024-11-20"],
                ["議事録.docx", 48, "2024-10-15"],
            ],
            ["name", "KB", "modified"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify all lines have the same column separators at the same positions
        separator_positions = []
        for line in lines[2:]:  # Skip header and separator line
            pos1 = line.find(" | ")
            if pos1 >= 0:
                # Find second separator
                pos2 = line.find(" | ", pos1 + 1)
                separator_positions.append((pos1, pos2))

        # All rows should have separators at the same positions
        assert len(separator_positions) > 0
        first_pos = separator_positions[0]
        for pos in separator_positions:
            assert pos == first_pos, f"Column separators not aligned: {pos} vs {first_pos}"


class TestEdgeCasesWithWideChars:
    """Test edge cases and corner cases with wide characters."""

    def test_empty_cells_with_japanese_header(self):
        """Empty cells should not break alignment when headers contain Japanese."""
        result = render(
            [["a", None], [None, "b"]],
            ["日本語", "English"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        separator_positions = [line.find(" | ") for line in lines[2:]]
        assert len(set(separator_positions)) == 1

    def test_single_japanese_char(self):
        """Single wide characters should be handled correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["a", "日"], ["日", "b"]],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        separator_positions = [line.find(" | ") for line in lines]
        assert len(set(separator_positions)) == 1

    def test_all_japanese_rows(self):
        """All Japanese rows should still have correct alignment."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["データ1", "値1"],
                ["データ2", "値2"],
                ["データ3", "値3"],
            ],
            ["名前", "値"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        separator_positions = [line.find(" | ") for line in lines[2:]]
        assert len(set(separator_positions)) == 1

    def test_max_width_with_pure_japanese(self):
        """max_width should work correctly with pure Japanese text."""
        result = render(
            [["日本語文字", "x"]],
            max_width=4,
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should be truncated
        assert "…" in lines[0]

    def test_very_long_japanese_text(self):
        """Very long Japanese text should be handled gracefully."""
        long_japanese = "日本語" * 20  # Lots of Japanese characters
        result = render(
            [[long_japanese, "data"]],
            max_width=10,
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should have truncation
        assert "…" in lines[0]

    def test_multiple_columns_with_max_width_japanese(self):
        """Multiple columns with max_width should stay aligned with Japanese."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["日本語データファイル.txt", "説明", "2024-11-22"],
                ["file.pdf", "text", "2024-11-20"],
            ],
            ["name", "type", "date"],
            max_width=8,
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Columns should still be aligned despite truncation
        separator_positions = []
        for line in lines[2:]:
            pos1 = line.find(" | ")
            pos2 = line.find(" | ", pos1 + 1) if pos1 >= 0 else -1
            if pos1 >= 0 and pos2 >= 0:
                separator_positions.append((pos1, pos2))

        if separator_positions:
            first_pos = separator_positions[0]
            for pos in separator_positions:
                assert pos == first_pos

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestJapaneseSingleCell:
    """Basic rendering of Japanese text without other columns."""
    
    def test_simple_japanese(self):
        """Single Japanese cell renders without error."""
        result = render([["レポート"]])
        assert "レポート" in result
    
    def test_japanese_header(self):
        """Japanese in header."""
        result = render([["123"]], headers=["名前"])
        assert "名前" in result
        assert "123" in result
        lines = result.split('\n')
        assert len(lines) == 3  # header, separator, data


class TestJapaneseMixedColumns:
    """Column alignment with Japanese text in different rows."""
    
    def test_japanese_then_ascii(self):
        """Japanese in first row, ASCII in second."""
        result = render([
            ["レポート", "12"],
            ["notes", "3"],
        ])
        lines = result.split('\n')
        assert len(lines) == 2
        # Separator positions should match (same column widths)
        sep_col_1 = lines[0].find('|')
        sep_col_2 = lines[1].find('|')
        assert sep_col_1 == sep_col_2, "Column separator should be in same position for all rows"
    
    def test_ascii_then_japanese(self):
        """ASCII in first row, Japanese in second."""
        result = render([
            ["notes", "3"],
            ["レポート", "12"],
        ])
        lines = result.split('\n')
        assert len(lines) == 2
        # Separator positions should match
        sep_col_1 = lines[0].find('|')
        sep_col_2 = lines[1].find('|')
        assert sep_col_1 == sep_col_2
    
    def test_japanese_all_rows(self):
        """Japanese in all rows should align correctly."""
        result = render([
            ["レポート", "日本"],
            ["あいうえお", "語"],
        ])
        lines = result.split('\n')
        sep_col_1 = lines[0].find('|')
        sep_col_2 = lines[1].find('|')
        assert sep_col_1 == sep_col_2


class TestJapaneseWithHeaders:
    """Japanese text with headers."""
    
    def test_japanese_data_ascii_header(self):
        """Japanese data with ASCII headers."""
        result = render([
            ["レポート", "12"],
            ["notes", "3"],
        ], headers=["name", "KB"])
        
        lines = result.split('\n')
        assert len(lines) == 4  # header, separator, row1, row2
        assert "name" in lines[0]
        assert "KB" in lines[0]
        
        # Separator position should match across data rows
        sep1 = lines[2].find('|')
        sep2 = lines[3].find('|')
        assert sep1 == sep2
    
    def test_japanese_header_and_data(self):
        """Japanese in both header and data."""
        result = render([
            ["レポート", "12"],
        ], headers=["ファイル", "サイズ"])
        
        lines = result.split('\n')
        assert len(lines) == 3  # header, separator, data
        assert "ファイル" in lines[0]
        assert "サイズ" in lines[0]
        assert "レポート" in lines[2]


class TestJapaneseIssueExample:
    """The exact scenario from the GitHub issue."""
    
    def test_file_listing_with_japanese(self):
        """Test the exact example from the issue."""
        result = render([
            ["レポート_2024.pdf", "12", "2024-11-02"],
            ["notes.txt", "3", "2024-11-20"],
            ["議事録.docx", "48", "2024-10-15"],
        ], headers=["name", "KB", "modified"])
        
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # Should have: header, separator, 3 data rows = 5 lines
        assert len(lines) == 5
        
        # All rows should have 2 separators (3 columns)
        for line in lines:
            if line:  # Non-empty lines
                assert line.count('|') == 2, f"Line has wrong number of separators: {repr(line)}"
        
        # Separator positions must be consistent across all data rows
        # Extract separator positions from header
        header_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == '|']
        
        for data_line_idx in [2, 3, 4]:  # Data rows (skip separator line)
            data_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[data_line_idx]) if c == '|']
            assert data_seps == header_seps, (
                f"Line {data_line_idx} separators {data_seps} don't match header {header_seps}"
            )

class TestJapaneseEdgeCases:
    """Edge cases with Japanese text."""
    
    def test_japanese_empty_cell(self):
        """Table with empty cells and Japanese."""
        result = render([
            ["レポート", None],
            [None, "12"],
        ])
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # Should handle None values without issues
        assert len(lines) == 2
        assert "レポート" in result
        assert "12" in result

        """Japanese mixed with ASCII in same cell."""

        ])
        assert "レポート_2024.pdf" in result
        assert "12" in result
        lines = result.split('\n')
        assert lines[0].count('|') == 1
    
    def test_many_japanese_rows(self):

        result = render([
            ["レポート", "1"],
            ["議事録", "2"],
            ["予算書", "3"],
            ["日程表", "4"],

        lines = result.split('\n')

        # All rows should have separators in same position
        sep_positions = []

            if '|' in line:
                sep_positions.append(line.find('|'))
        
        # All separator positions should be identical
        assert len(set(sep_positions)) == 1, "All separators should be at same column"
    
    def test_long_japanese_name(self):
        """Very long Japanese filename."""
        result = render([
            ["レポート_2024年上半期_売上実績_詳細分析.xlsx", "1500"],
        ], headers=["name", "KB"])
        
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # Should handle long text without crashing
        assert "レポート" in result
        assert "1500" in result

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestJapaneseSingleColumn:
    """Tests for Japanese text in a single column."""

    def test_japanese_header_ascii_data(self):
        """Japanese header with ASCII data should align properly."""
        result = render([["notes.txt"], ["file.pdf"]], ["名前"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All lines should have same visual width
        assert lines[0].startswith("名前")
        # Check that separator and data rows align
        assert lines[1].startswith("----")
        
    def test_ascii_header_japanese_data(self):
        """ASCII header with Japanese data should align properly."""
        result = render([["レポート"], ["メモ"]], ["name"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All content lines should have correct alignment
        assert len(lines) == 3  # header, separator, data
        # Data lines should be properly padded
        assert "レポート" in result
        assert "メモ" in result

    def test_mixed_japanese_ascii_data(self):
        """Column with mixed Japanese and ASCII should pad correctly."""
        result = render([["レポート"], ["notes"], ["x"]], ["item"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All data rows should be properly aligned
        assert len(lines) == 5  # header, separator, 3 data rows
        # Japanese text should not cause misalignment
        assert "レポート" in result
        assert "notes" in result

class TestJapaneseWithTruncation:
    """Tests for Japanese text with max_width truncation."""

    def test_japanese_truncation_basic(self):
        """Japanese text should truncate with ellipsis."""
        result = render([["レポート"]], max_width=4)
        # With 2-char width for each Japanese char (8 total), max_width=4 should truncate
        assert "…" in result or "レポ" in result
        # Result should not exceed max_width visually
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Character length might be more than display width, that's ok
        # But no line should crash or be malformed
        for line in lines:
            assert isinstance(line, str)

    def test_japanese_truncation_with_ascii(self):
        """Truncation with mixed Japanese and ASCII."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024.pdf", "x"]],
            max_width=10
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        assert len(lines) == 1
        # Should handle truncation without crashing
        assert " | " in result

    def test_ascii_truncation_still_works(self):
        """ASCII truncation should still work correctly."""
        result = render([["abcdefgh", "x"]], max_width=5)
        # This is from existing test - should still pass
        assert result == "abcd… | x"

class TestJapaneseConsistency:
    """Tests to verify consistent behavior across different scenarios."""

    def test_header_and_data_alignment_consistency(self):
        """Headers and data should align consistently."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート", "12"],
                ["notes", "3"]
            ],
            ["name", "KB"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Header line and data lines should have consistent column positions
        header_line = lines[0]
        sep_line = lines[1]
        data1_line = lines[2]
        data2_line = lines[3]
        
        # All lines should have same number of separators
        assert header_line.count("|") == 1
        assert data1_line.count("|") == 1
        assert data2_line.count("|") == 1

    def test_no_trailing_spaces(self):
        """Output should have no trailing spaces on any line."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート", "12"],
                ["notes", "3"]
            ],
            ["name", "KB"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        for line in lines:
            assert line == line.rstrip(), f"Line has trailing spaces: {repr(line)}"

    def test_round_trip_stability(self):
        """Multiple renders should produce identical output."""
        data = [["レポート", "12"], ["notes", "3"]]
        headers = ["name", "KB"]
        
        result1 = render(data, headers)
        result2 = render(data, headers)
        
        assert result1 == result2
